audit_items.proof_trace: `supplyTokens()` always calls `_verifyCanSupplyTokens()`, which reverts with `TokensNotAllocated` if `totalTokensAllocated == 0`. `totalTokensAllocated` is set non-zero only by `publishSaleResults()` (FixedPrice/SealedBid/PreLiquidOpenApplication) or `publishTgeDetails()` (PreLiquidApprovedSale), both `onlyLegion` gated. No code path resets it to zero, so `totalTokensAllocated != 0` is a sound proxy for `resultsPublished == true`.
